user_manual.detail: Closed cards do not publish new unread-result notices; waiting cards and previously published pending notices retain their existing behavior.

reusable_learning.reason: The shared work-ledger guide documents the status boundary and preservation rule.

validation.regressions: Two closed-card scenarios fail before the guard. Waiting-human and escalated-human result observation already passes and remains covered. Reopening after changed result bytes adds one event without deleting the original pending event.
